content: PWA offline storage: IndexedDB for structured data (parsed cues, metadata, user settings). Cache API for app shell/assets (HTML, CSS, JS). OPFS for raw file blobs (less supported). Recommendation: store parsed subtitle cues in IndexedDB with indexes on start/end times for fast lookup. Cache API for offline app loading. Use idb-keyval or Dexie.js for simpler IndexedDB API. Storage is shared quota across all origin storage types.
